title: Lancaster Go-Around Practice with Mike | Cockpit & Wing Views
description: Join Mike and me for a relaxed flight over Lancaster as we practice several go-arounds and put some air over the plane to help dry it out after a wash.  The video features both cockpit and wing views, along with plenty of local scenery from the air. '74 Piper Warrior

title: Flying the RNAV 06 Approach into Lancaster (KLKR) | Piper Warrior
description: Flying the RNAV 06 instrument approach into Lancaster County–McWhirter Field (KLKR) while completing approaches for IFR currency. This flight took place on April 26, 2026, in Mike Morgan’s Piper Warrior PA-28-151. The cellphone footage was recorded on the spur of the moment and offers a look at a real-world practice instrument approach.
